name: Spotlight Cursor
description: Full-screen image backdrop with a soft blurred spotlight that follows the pointer and blends with the picture, revealing and inverting colors under the cursor.
contents: Full-viewport image layer with overlay blend
behavior: Spotlight is centered on the pointer through a window pointermove listener
Spotlight uses a configurable CSS mix-blend-mode against the image
editableByProps: Spotlight size, falloff and blend mode

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the spotlight color or gradient
needsCodeEdit.where: radial-gradient background in the cursorRef element style

fixed: Root is fixed and covers the whole viewport, so it takes over the screen and sits above page content unless layered with z-index through className
